verdict.rationale: Mail-data privacy and tracking protection are fair questions for an email provider, but the evidence never mentions blocking read or tracking pixels, image proxying, or a data-use transparency policy. SOC 2 reporting and sender allow/block Lists are adjacent controls, not this capability.

support.subject: As a switcher, the client protects me from senders' tracking — blocking read pixels by default — and is transparent about what it does with my mail data
